first-light.line: The moment the light in the frame's core holds for good.
first-light.short: The moment the light in the frame's core holds for good. Chang'e's mother gives it that name.
first-light.summary: The first light is the moment the light in the frame's core held for good. Chang'e kept her palm on the copper plate while her mother counted past three hundred. The light did not shake, and the frame hummed for the first time. Lesley was away and missed it. Her mother's notebook records it on its last page, and later Chang'e wanted the Academy built where it happened.
rows: The frame in the lab of the research base
Chang'e, with her mother and father
first-light.sub: first steady light of the core

fish-market-raid.line: A raid on a shore ward, where the dome tore over the fish stalls.
fish-market-raid.short: A raid on the fish market, weeks before the newcomers became Aspirants. Enders drop through a tear in the dome over the stalls.
fish-market-raid.summary: A raid on a shore ward, weeks before the newcomers became Aspirants. Professor Joe sent the Layla-Fanny Team to the west end and Guinevere and Vexana to the east, and Enders dropped through a tear in the dome over the stalls. Around the thirtieth minute Guinevere's wings went out on a roof, and Vexana caught her. Guinevere blamed a crosswind, but there was no wind on that roof. One of her drones came back broken. Ever since, Vexana has kept a step nearer Guinevere's back.
rows: The fish market, on a shore ward
Weeks before the newcomers became Aspirants

founding-of-selrick-academy.line: The bright morning the Academy first opened its gate.
founding-of-selrick-academy.short: The morning Selrick Academy opens. Its instructors fly over the city in suits on wings of light, and the crowd cheers.
founding-of-selrick-academy.summary: On a bright morning the old gate opened under the name Selrick Academy, on the ruins of the research base. Lesley became Chief Combat Instructor and Chang'e director of the Science Division. The instructors flew suits in a line over the city on wings of light. No suit had flown over it before, and people cheered along the fence. Lesley saluted Chang'e, and Chang'e saluted back with the wrong hand. Young Guinevere watched from the House on the hill, and Selena from the fence.
rows: The old gate of the research base, Terrinia
Lesley, Chief Combat Instructor; Chang'e, director of the Science Division
Guinevere from the House on the hill, Selena at the fence

guards-block.line: A purple and gold machine takes the Mother Matrix's shot for Guinevere.
guards-block.short: A machine of purple plate edged in gold drops between Guinevere and the Mother Matrix's beam, and holds. Chang'e says it is not the Enders'.
guards-block.summary: When the Mother Matrix fired at Guinevere behind a low wall, a machine of purple plate edged in gold dropped in front of the light with its arms up. It held while the beam melted the road to glass on either side. It was Vexana's Guard, and she was inside it. It ran on her belief and spent all of it on that one block, and fire through its seams burned her left arm. Guinevere only half remembers a back between her and the glare.
rows: A street west of the platforms

landing-in-terrinia.line: Oro's mission to Planet Dawnbreak and its landing in Terrinia.
landing-in-terrinia.short: Oro's mission to Planet Dawnbreak. The orders: save the Rioters and restore balance. Ruby's trojan is set to wake during it.
landing-in-terrinia.summary: Oro sent its android company to Planet Dawnbreak with orders to save the Rioters and restore balance. That evening Terrinia burned. A giant Ender stood over the roofs while a black ship let the androids out, and they struck at Selrick students. Ruby tore the control unit out of Angela's back and cut down the whole company, and the two brought down a giant together. Then Oro's soldiers arrested them, and they went quietly so the street would not burn more. Across the city, Layla, Fanny, Guinevere and Vexana held the line against the giants.

late-night-calls.line: Vexana's late phone calls telling Guinevere to go to bed.
late-night-calls.short: Vexana's late-night phone calls to Guinevere, telling her to go to bed.
late-night-calls.summary: Every night, late, Vexana phoned Guinevere to tell her to go to bed. Guinevere bargained, "Ten more," then "Five. You can count them." She answered "I'm asleep" on the first night, and not again until the night she said it from the training hall. To Vexana the words meant goodnight, and the promise of another night. After Vexana was taken the calls stopped. Vexana still knows Guinevere's number by heart, written in gold ink and underlined twice: For emergencies. Or anything.

mother-matrixs-attack.line: The Mother Matrix's attack on Terrinia through the Singularity.
mother-matrixs-attack.short: The Singularity tears open over the bay. Enders pour through purple portals inside the dome and turn inland for the Academy.
mother-matrixs-attack.summary: The morning the Singularity tore open over the bay, the sky went dark as dusk and sirens rang in every ward. For the first time Enders came through purple portals inside the dome, instead of clawing in from outside, and they turned inland for the Academy's wards. The Mother Matrix itself came halfway through the sky over the platforms, then stepped out whole, and nearly half the city fell to rubble. Struck in the chest, it staggered back into the light at the star's edge.

newcomers-arrival.line: Ruby and Angela come down a black ship's ramp and ask Selrick for refuge.
newcomers-arrival.short: A black ship lands by the dome's foot, and Ruby and Angela walk down its ramp. Ruby asks Selrick for refuge.
newcomers-arrival.summary: A siren warned of an unknown craft coming down at the city's edge. The gate portal dropped Fanny and Layla at a cleared lot by the dome's foot, where soldiers, Guinevere, Vexana and Lesley waited. A black ship landed, and Ruby and Angela walked down its ramp. Ruby planted her scythe, bowed and called herself an heir. Fanny vouched for them, and Ruby asked Selrick for refuge. Lesley let them in under watch, and Ruby accepted Chang'e's four conditions.
rows: A cleared lot by the dome's foot
Days after the black ships landed

night-the-enders-came-back.line: The night the Enders return after a long quiet, with fires across the city.
night-the-enders-came-back.short: After a long quiet the Enders come back at night. Fires burn across the city, and sirens sound.
night-the-enders-came-back.summary: After a long quiet the Enders came back at night, with fires across the city. Chang'e held the doors of the seawall shelter alone, and Mr. Bunny fought as a giant machine. Lesley drew an Ender off her from a lit tower window, and Chang'e looked straight up at that window. Together they brought down a giant, then two more big ones before dawn, and Chang'e's crescents flew farther with Lesley at her back. The Academy later calls the two of them the First Aspirants.

northeastern-sector-breach.line: The Ender attack that tore the dome over the Northeastern sector.
northeastern-sector-breach.short: Ultra Enders rip a breach eight meters by two in the dome over the Northeastern sector. Every tutor is called through the gate portal.
northeastern-sector-breach.summary: Ultra Enders ripped a breach in the dome over the Northeastern sector, and every tutor went through the gate portal. A falling slab struck Professor Joe down as he shielded a little girl. Layla killed the Ender at the breach with one shot, and she and Fanny joined forces for the first time, while Guinevere and Vexana held the other end of the wall. When a gold giant broke the dome in a ring, Layla and Fanny destroyed it together. At sunset the swarm drew back. Obsidia says so many Enders broken at once by human hands is the step that brings the Mother Matrix down.
rows: Four instructors off the field roster, Professor Joe among the hurt

one-arm-match.line: A night match, one arm each, between Guinevere and Vexana.
one-arm-match.short: Guinevere's challenge after she finds a wound Vexana hid. They fight one arm each, at night, in the training hall.
one-arm-match.summary: Sparring, Guinevere caught Vexana's wrist and found a bandage with blood on it under the glove. Vexana had told no one. That night, under the center lamp of the empty training hall, they fought one arm each. If Guinevere won, Vexana would tell her first, every cut. Each hooked the other's ankle in the same moment, they landed side by side, and Vexana laughed. It was a draw, so both made the rule: partners tell each other first.

promise-on-the-roof.line: Guinevere and Vexana's promise, on a city roof, to protect this world.
promise-on-the-roof.short: On a city roof Guinevere gives Vexana one of two gold stars she made. They promise to protect this world, the two of them.
promise-on-the-roof.summary: After their quarrel Guinevere asked Vexana to a city roof at noon, in a one-line plan. There she gave her one of the two Emblems of Hope she had made herself. When the two made peace, the stars began to glow, and Guinevere took a phone photo of them both, a gold star lit at each collar. She said, "We protect this world. The two of us," and Vexana answered, "A promise." On the platforms, long after, Guinevere reminds Vexana of it.
rows: A city roof with green guardrails
One of the two Emblems of Hope

quarrel-over-the-gifts.line: Guinevere and Vexana's fight over the shopping bags.
quarrel-over-the-gifts.short: Vexana returns all the shopping bags with a note, and Guinevere takes it badly. Vexana tells her, "I am not something you buy."
quarrel-over-the-gifts.summary: Before dawn after the shopping trip, Vexana left every bag at Guinevere's door with a note: I cannot repay this. Guinevere called it a present. Vexana told her, "I am not something you buy." Guinevere's father answered everything with money, and that word had been used against her before. She took the bags back, shut her door all the way, and all the next day loudly did not speak to Vexana. On the roof Vexana admitted the word had been a lie in her mouth too.

raid-at-the-domes-foot.line: The reserve's fight at a split in the dome, three days after Team-Up Day.
raid-at-the-domes-foot.short: Three days after Team-Up Day, Enders climb through a split at the dome's foot, and the reserve is sent to stop them.
raid-at-the-domes-foot.summary: On the third day after Team-Up Day a siren sent the reserve to the dome's foot, where Enders were climbing through a split. The singles went to the side streets with one order: nobody goes alone. Guinevere ran alone up the street that led to the split, and a claw from a doorway raked her right arm. Vexana had followed a street back. She reached her and held out her hand, and they fought back to back until the street held.
rows: A side street at the dome's foot

raid-of-selenas-childhood.line: A night raid in the rain when Selena was small.
raid-of-selenas-childhood.short: A raid on Selena's block when she was small. Lost from the shelter line in the rain, she meets an Ender, and it walks past her.
raid-of-selenas-childhood.summary: It came at night, in rain, while Karina was on shift. The whole block went down the stairs toward the shelter. Then something hit two streets over, the line broke, and the hand holding Selena's let go. Alone in a side street, she met an Ender coming round the corner. It looked at her for one breath, then walked on past. A window shard opened her forearm, and fine purple threads drew the cut shut.

rail-yard-shot.line: Lesley's shot that split a piece of an Ender's core away whole.
rail-yard-shot.short: At the old rail yard Lesley aims at the edge of an Ender's core, not its middle, and a piece of it splits away whole.
rail-yard-shot.summary: Three Enders walked into the old rail yard, and a squad went to ground behind a wagon. Lesley moved her sight off the middle of an Ender's core to its edge. A piece of the core split away whole before the burn reached it. Nobody had thought it could be done, and afterward Shield officers knew Lesley by that shot.

rescue-operation.line: Layla's plan to reach Guinevere through the Enders.
rescue-operation.short: Layla's plan to reach Guinevere, who has flown at the Singularity. Layla marks the Enders' weak points in green on her tablet.
rescue-operation.summary: When Guinevere flew straight at the Singularity, Layla marked the weak points in the Enders' lines in green on her tablet and said the rescue operation was ready to go. Lesley sent the frontline on Layla's plan, with rear support on their heels, and Fanny dropped her own order and told Layla to lead. Lesley told Layla where Guinevere was and to get to her if she could. The team could not break through to her.

return-from-the-black-hole.line: Guinevere and Vexana come back out of the black hole as two lights.
return-from-the-black-hole.short: Inside the black hole Guinevere's warmth and hands come back. The two stars flare gold and violet, and their light pierces the void.
return-from-the-black-hole.summary: After their strike the black point took Guinevere and Vexana. Inside it, warmth came back into Guinevere and her hands returned. Their two stars flared together, gold and violet, and the light pierced the void. Two lights shot out of the Singularity's center, rose over the Matrix's crown and came down at its chest together from the city's side. The body gave way, and the Mother Matrix went slowly back into the star. Every suit's power climbed again, and Chang'e says no reading had ever come back out of a black hole before.
rows: The black hole at the Singularity's center

reunion-on-the-platform.line: Guinevere and Vexana join hands again on the platform.
reunion-on-the-platform.short: On the platform Guinevere holds out her hand and asks Vexana to stay with her. Vexana takes it with her burned hand.
reunion-on-the-platform.summary: Vexana told Guinevere she had seen the end that awaits them. Guinevere crouched and held out her hand, palm up. "Stay with me, Vexana," she said, and Vexana took it with her burned hand and did not let go. Layla lowered her cannon: "It's not a trap." Vexana cried "Hope never dies!" and everyone, Fanny too, answered "The Aspirants always stand united!" Then the two rose side by side toward the Mother Matrix's crowned head.
rows: The city platforms, above the bay

rooftop-talk.line: Layla and Fanny's talk on a ruined roof the night of the battle.
rooftop-talk.short: On a ruined roof after the battle, Fanny tells Layla about her elder brother Tigreal, and the two agree to train together again.
rooftop-talk.summary: On a ruined roof the night of the battle, Layla admitted that Fanny has skill. Fanny told her about her elder brother, Tigreal. Layla understood that Fanny had never looked down on her, only past her at her brother. Layla proposed they train together again, and they said together that they must get stronger, because they are the protectors of all humanity. Every session since opens with the sergeants' line: "There is no place for mercy on the battlefield."

science-division-entry.line: Selena's entry test for the Academy's Science Division.
science-division-entry.short: Selena's entry test for the Science Division. It is like a children's game to her, but the family-name box on her form is empty.
science-division-entry.summary: Chang'e told Selena the Science Division took its entry the next week. To Selena the test was like a children's game. She finished early and drew a four-legged machine with a long tail on the back of the paper. Her empty family-name box glowed red on the form, but nobody said anything, and the examiner called the next name. The result was Science Division. On her first day the box was green, and she never learned who cleared it.

search-for-vexana.line: The weeks Guinevere kept saying Vexana was alive.
search-for-vexana.short: The weeks after Vexana goes missing. At the long table and in the counseling room, Guinevere says Vexana is alive.
search-for-vexana.summary: All through the weeks Vexana was missing, Guinevere said at the long table and in the counseling room that she was alive. Every morning she touched her star with two fingers. It stayed lit the whole time, and for weeks it was her only proof. Angela told the table, "I came back once. People come back." On the night no call came, Guinevere had called Vexana's number out of habit and followed the ring to the box in her room.

seawall-raid.line: The fifth raid in nine days, fought by the seawall.
seawall-raid.short: The fifth raid in nine days, in a street of shut shops by the seawall. Vexana takes a claw on her left arm for Guinevere.
seawall-raid.summary: The fifth raid in nine days, fought in a street of shut shops by the seawall. Since the newcomers came, the raids had grown fiercer and come nearer the Academy's waterfront. Vexana took a claw on her left arm for Guinevere, who called "Did you get it?" without turning round. Vexana dressed the cut herself and hid it for four days, until Guinevere found it and called for the one-arm match.
rows: A street of shut shops by the seawall

shopping-trip.line: Guinevere's day of shopping with Vexana in the arcade.
shopping-trip.short: The day after the team test, Guinevere takes Vexana shopping in the arcade because they won, and pays with her black card.
shopping-trip.summary: The day after they won the team test, Guinevere took Vexana shopping in the arcade, with two House guards following. Guinevere paid for everything with her black card. Vexana secretly bought pink and black felt with her own stipend. Before dawn she left all the bags at Guinevere's door with a note, and the quarrel over the gifts began.
rows: The day after the team test

small-light-in-the-void.line: A lone light Obsidia sees far off in the void.
small-light-in-the-void.short: A small light Obsidia sees far off in the void. It is not an Ender's, and nothing is dying there. She tells no one.
small-light-in-the-void.summary: As the Storm Citadel's crossing ended, Obsidia saw one small light far off in the dark, past the body. It was not an Ender's. She knew its kind: she had felt it in every Ender that ever died of it. But here it burned in the void, and nothing was dying. She marked the place and sent nothing of it up the line. Later, in Vexana's hidden hollow, Obsidia says she marked that fold the night her ship came through.
rows: The void, past the Will's body

storm-night-of-983.line: The night in 983 when Obsidia's storm darkened the city and her Enders struck.
storm-night-of-983.short: In 983 the Storm Citadel's violet storm kills every human machine, and Obsidia's Enders strike the sleeping city after midnight.
storm-night-of-983.summary: In 983 the Storm Citadel came over Terrinia after midnight, a black cloud with violet light over the bay, and its storm killed every lamp, radio and siren, street by street. Obsidia's Enders struck while people slept. A tall gray Ender broke into Lesley's home and took her left eye, and her father, mother and brother were killed. Guinevere's mother never came home. That night Obsidia carried down Selena, the child she had made, and set her in the mud, where a woman with a lamp gathered her up. When the Citadel left, the street lamps came back on.
rows: Obsidia, with the Storm Citadel and her Enders
Lesley's father, mother and brother, and many in their nightclothes
Fourteen years later the Academy story begins

strike-on-the-mother-matrix.line: Guinevere and Vexana's double strike at the Mother Matrix's open chest.
strike-on-the-mother-matrix.short: Layla and Fanny draw the Mother Matrix's fire so its chest opens, and Guinevere and Vexana dive in and strike it together.
strike-on-the-mother-matrix.summary: Layla's plan drew the Matrix's fire onto the shield, so its chest would open away from the two girls. Layla's shot and Fanny's arcs struck the crowned head, and the chest plates split. Guinevere and Vexana dove in, a gold star and a violet one. "This strike is for Vexana," cried Guinevere. "This strike is for Guinevere!" cried Vexana. Fist beside staff, they hit the open chest, and the Matrix staggered back. Then the black point took hold of them both, and the dark took them.

summer-fireworks.line: The summer night Guinevere and Vexana watched fireworks at the dome's edge.
summer-fireworks.short: The Academy's summer fireworks. Guinevere and Vexana slip out after curfew to watch them from the dome's edge.
summer-fireworks.summary: The Academy's summer fireworks start after the curfew bell. Guinevere asked Vexana to watch them at the dome's edge, and they slipped out by the kitchen yard gate. On open dark ground pink and gold bursts cracked overhead, and Vexana gripped Guinevere's hand at the first rocket. Guinevere pointed at the sky, and Vexana watched her face. Guinevere said they would be just like fireworks, shining at their absolute brightest. Vexana smiled, and both stars went bright. When Vexana tells Obsidia of it in the void, Obsidia answers: "Fireworks. Then dark."
rows: Open ground at the dome's edge

summer-outing.line: A summer day at a cake shop and an amusement park.
summer-outing.short: Guinevere takes Vexana to the girls' house, a cake shop, then to the amusement park, with Hester and the cake box behind them.
summer-outing.summary: That summer Guinevere took Vexana to the girls' house, a cake shop under a pink awning, and ordered one of everything on the top row. Vexana paid for the second pot of tea herself. At the amusement park Hester followed them all afternoon with the cake box. Near the way out Guinevere bought matching doll keychains, one black-haired and one pink-haired. At the gate the box went to Vexana as a midnight snack.
rows: The girls' house and the amusement park

taking-of-vexana.line: The day a door in an Academy corridor took Vexana.
taking-of-vexana.short: Enders break in at the dome's seaward foot, and a small purple-edged door opens in the Investigation Room corridor and takes Vexana.
taking-of-vexana.summary: An alarm reported a breach at the dome's seaward foot and Enders in the Investigation Room wing. In the corridor a small purple-edged door opened in the white wall behind Guinevere. Vexana stepped in front of her, and the door took her. For a moment a small gold point still showed where her collar had been. Chang'e says such a door inside the dome almost never happens. Obsidia reads in the pulse that it was the Will's first move: take one of the two girls who fought as one, and the other breaks. By evening the board said VEXANA: MISSING.
rows: The Investigation Room corridor, Selrick Academy

team-b3-drill.line: Team B3's VR drill against Enders on a copy of the Academy grounds.
team-b3-drill.short: Team B3's VR drill on a copy of the Academy grounds. Fanny blades the Enders up close, and Layla shoots from a doorway.
team-b3-drill.summary: Team B3's VR drill copied the Academy grounds. Fanny bladed each Ender's open chest as it struck, and Layla fired low charge from a doorway. When Roger ran across open ground, Fanny's cable stopped a claw a meter above his face, and Layla's shot passed Fanny's ear into the core, a finger from Roger's face. The team took out 33 enemies within 10 minutes. Layla defeated 16, one more than Fanny, but the sixteenth had been on Fanny's cable.
rows: A VR copy of the Academy grounds

team-test.line: The Academy's pair test against steel dummies on six rails.
team-test.short: A pair test. Two stand in a chalk square while steel dummies come down six rails at once, and a pair is out if a steel arm touches either.
team-test.summary: In the team test a pair stood in a chalk square while steel dummies came down all six rails at once, and a pair was out the moment a steel arm touched either. Guinevere's plan for the day said "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)" In the fourth minute Vexana's staff split and went dark. Guinevere held the front alone, calling herself the herald of dawn, while Vexana knelt behind her and fitted a brass collar to the grip. At the bell both were still standing. They won.

test-match.line: Layla and Fanny's match against practice drones in the white corridor.
test-match.short: Layla and Fanny's end-of-week match against practice drones in the white training corridor, with a kill counter over each girl's head.
test-match.summary: At the week's end Layla and Fanny fought a test match against practice drones in the white training corridor. A counter over each girl's head showed her kills, and the swarm was shared. Layla's full-charge shot pulled left, a hand's width past Fanny's shoulder, and took only one drone. Fanny's counter stopped at 0157 and Layla's at 0151. The last red error line in Layla's log is dated that night.

way-home.line: A door out of the void that opens onto Vexana's own world.
way-home.short: A door opens out of the void onto dead ground beside the ruined tower. Vexana could walk home through it.
way-home.summary: The dark split open with no violet edge, and cold salt night air and the smell of rain blew through. The door opened on a rise of dead ground beside the ruined tower. Vexana's boot came down on wet stone, and it held. She thought that once she walked down there, no door would open back in. She took one step back and returned to the void, and nobody saw her go.
rows: Dead ground beside the ruined tower

wills-vision.line: The vision of the end that the Will of the Planet shows Vexana.
wills-vision.short: The Will of the Planet shows Vexana a burning city, something winged coming down, and Guinevere fallen. It calls this her end.
wills-vision.summary: In the void the Will of the Planet showed Vexana a city burning under a black sky and something vast and winged coming down through the torn sky over the Academy's tower. Vexana knelt in rubble, Guinevere and the others lay without moving, and her star crumbled into sparks. The Will said, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future," and called it the universe's predetermined execution. Vexana took from it that even as an Aspirant beside Guinevere, they lose. Obsidia says it was no judgment because the judging was done before.

years-showing.line: The Academy's yearly exhibition, where Silverbolt stood on show.
years-showing.short: The Academy's yearly showing. Selena's machine Silverbolt stands on a plinth in the hall, behind a rope and a crowd.
years-showing.summary: At the year's showing Silverbolt stood on a plinth in the hall, behind a rope and a crowd. A Combat Division boy told Selena she would be a hero with it, and she said she would pass. That week her file gained the line Outstanding Student, and since then half the Academy knows her name.

vexanas-stand-in-the-ring.line: Vexana alone on the platform against a ring of Enders.
vexanas-stand-in-the-ring.short: The Enders ring Vexana on the platform. When the Will's mark lets go of her, they close in to kill, and she fights them alone.
vexanas-stand-in-the-ring.summary: The Enders followed Vexana up the stair and made a ring around her on the platform. When the Will's mark, the cold point behind her breastbone, let go, the ring closed in to kill. She fought them with one arm, shot by shot, and said "Dissolve into the dark of night" as she shot a tall Ender through the chest. The last Ender fell across her boots. The fight took all the power she had gathered.
rows: The scorched platform above the bay

vexanas-transformation.line: Vexana's change into dark armor in the void.
vexanas-transformation.short: In the void cold comes up through Vexana, and the dark pours over her clothes and becomes armor. Her hair turns blue-lavender.
vexanas-transformation.summary: After she turned back from the way home, cold came up from Vexana's boots to the bone and numbed everything it touched. The dark poured over her clothes and became armor, but under the plates her own heart was still beating. Her hair turned blue-lavender, darkening to magenta at the ends. After it, the black-haired keychain on Guinevere's arm guard no longer looks like her.

ai-droids.line: Slim white Academy helper robots with one orange eye.
ai-droids.short: Slim white helper robots with one orange eye. Half serve the Combat Division and half the Support Division.
ai-droids.summary: AI droids are the Academy's slim white helpers, each with one orange eye. Half serve the Combat Division and half the Support Division, and they sit on Chang'e's repair queue. One of Chang'e's conditions for the newcomers was that a droid follow them everywhere, and one glided up and stopped a step behind Ruby.
rows: Slim and white, with one orange eye
The Combat Division and the Support Division

angelas-shield.line: A pane of light from Angela's palm, wide as a door.
angelas-shield.short: A pane of pale light that flies from Angela's palm and opens in front of her, wide as a door. She calls "Deploying shield!"
angelas-shield.summary: A pane of pale light flies from Angela's palm and opens wide as a door. At setting nine it cracks from edge to edge. In the battle with the Mother Matrix it stood as a bell of pink light around four of them on the platform. Angela opened panes in it for shots and shut them before the next claw. It dimmed where claws dug in, then swelled and threw the nearest Enders back. Under the Storm Citadel's field it flickered out, and when the field died it opened again over the wounded.
rows: Pale pink light, a pane wide as a door or a bell over several people

aspirant-suits.line: Armored suits rebuilt from dead Enders and run on belief.
aspirant-suits.short: Armored mecha suits rebuilt from dead Enders. They run on belief, which people call aspirant power.
aspirant-suits.summary: Aspirant suits are armored mecha built from Ender wreckage and woken by belief: a pilot's aspirant power lights the core, and the core moves the suit. Chang'e finished the first ones, but no Shield soldier could make them move until Lesley chose instructors with the dial. On the Academy's opening day they flew over the city on wings of light. Professor Joe says two who trust each other pull more from a suit than the same two apart, which is why Aspirants fight in pairs. Under the Storm Citadel's field every suit went dark.
rows: Ender wreckage, listed as salvage plating
Belief: the pilot's aspirant power lights the suit's one core
No change to a registered mecha without a field-test report and Chang'e's mark

weapons.name: Core
weapons.note: One to a suit. The pilot's aspirant power lights it, and the core moves the suit.

weapons.name: Plates
weapons.note: Gray plates bolted over steel, made from Ender bodies.

weapons.name: Wings of light
weapons.note: Open at the suit's back and let it fly.

black-ships.line: Oro's black starships, which cross between planets.
black-ships.short: Oro's black starships. One carries Angela and Oro's androids across the stars, the androids standing in its dark hold.
black-ships.summary: Oro's black ships carry the Balance Keepers from planet to planet, and Angela with them. One crossed the stars to Planet Dawnbreak with androids standing in its dark hold, and opened its hatch on a burning street in Terrinia. Nine stand on their pads in the secret facility's launch bay. Ruby and Angela escaped Oro in the ship that had brought them back, and it settled on a cleared lot by the dome's foot. On Dawnbreak everyone knows the ships came from beyond the sky, and nobody knows more.
rows: A ramp, a hatch and a hold, with a voice from the ceiling

black-haired-keychain.line: Guinevere's tiny big-headed doll of a black-haired Vexana.
black-haired-keychain.short: A tiny big-headed Vexana with long black hair, from the park. Guinevere clips it to her arm guard, where her fist swings.
black-haired-keychain.summary: A tiny big-headed doll of Vexana with long black hair, bought at the park when Guinevere gave Vexana the pink-haired one. It hung at Guinevere's belt until the end of the first week Vexana was gone. Then Guinevere clipped it to her arm guard, where it swings out ahead of every punch. Once Vexana's hair changes, it no longer looks like her. Guinevere still wears it on her cracked arm guard and touches it when she sees Vexana's keychain.

brass-collar.line: A band of brass that holds the cracked grip of Vexana's staff.
brass-collar.short: A brass band Vexana fits over the split in her staff's grip during the team test. It was a spare from her father's toolbox.
brass-collar.summary: A band of brass around the cracked grip of Vexana's staff. It was a spare from her father's toolbox, kept for the gun sights on the city wall. She fitted it at the team test with a little screwdriver, kneeling behind Guinevere while Guinevere held the front alone. In hard moments her thumb presses it, and she tries it with her fingers the way her father tried each sight on the wall. It does not give.
rows: A spare in her father's toolbox

caramel-pudding.line: Caramel pudding cups, left outside Chang'e's lab door.
caramel-pudding.short: A caramel pudding cup left outside Chang'e's lab door with no note, the spoon laid across the lid. Caramel is the right flavor.
caramel-pudding.summary: Caramel was the flavor Chang'e's mother handed round at the research base, one cup each, after late nights and to celebrate the first light. Chang'e wrote SIS on a fourth cup for Lesley, and after her parents died she pushed it to the back of the cold box. Since the founding night a cup has turned up outside her lab door after every long night, the spoon laid square across the lid, never a note. Lesley leaves them. At the end Chang'e says she is owed a pudding, and Lesley answers, "Two."

changes-console.line: Chang'e's console on the command deck.
changes-console.short: Chang'e's console on the command deck. Its map tracks the Enders, and thin lines down its side show the power of every suit in the city.
changes-console.summary: Chang'e's console on the command deck. Its map tracks the Enders' red marks, and a column of thin lines shows the power of every suit in the city, as close as anyone comes to reading belief. When the Mother Matrix came, the lines fell all at once, and they climbed again after Guinevere and Vexana returned. Under the Storm Citadel's field they went flat, a speck of gold last, and when it died they jumped at once, the gold one first. A thin trace from the morning still runs at its bottom, with no name.
rows: A map of the city and a power line for every suit

changes-mothers-notebook.line: The research notebook of Chang'e's mother.
changes-mothers-notebook.short: Chang'e's mother's notes on the frame, in her quick hand. They fill one notebook, then a second.
changes-mothers-notebook.summary: Chang'e's mother wrote her notes on the frame in her quick hand, and they filled one notebook, then a second. The last page records the first light: held past three hundred, no shaking, C.'s hand on the plate. Then "Next:", and the line stops. After her parents died, Chang'e wrote under it in letters twice the size: Make it something a soldier can wear.
rows: Make it something a soldier can wear, in Chang'e's hand

chibi-keychains.line: A matching pair of tiny big-headed doll keychains.
chibi-keychains.short: A chibi keychain is a tiny big-headed doll. Guinevere wears a black-haired Vexana, and Vexana a pink-haired Guinevere.
chibi-keychains.summary: Tiny big-headed doll keychains, sold at the amusement park in every hair color. Guinevere hung a black-haired one on her own belt and pressed a pink-haired one into Vexana's palm. "Now you have me on yours," she said. Vexana keeps hers in the white box at night and wears it by day.

control-core.line: Whatever steers all the Enders, hidden in the Will's dark void.
control-core.short: Whatever steers all the Enders, Chang'e says. It is hidden in the Will's dark void, and only destroying it can defeat the Will.
control-core.summary: Chang'e says the Control Core is whatever steers all the Enders, hidden in the Will of the Planet's dark void, and that only destroying it can defeat the Will. Smashing it was Guinevere's Plan A, and Vexana searched the void for it and found only dark. Obsidia says it is the knot where the Will's threads to every Ender meet: break it and the Will has no hands, hold it and the Enders answer whoever holds it. She has never been shown it and does not know where it is.
rows: Unknown; Chang'e says it is hidden in the Will's dark void

crescents.line: Chang'e's floating crescent pieces, white edged with pink.
crescents.short: Floating crescent pieces Chang'e builds to keep herself safe. White edged with pink, they rise and circle her.
crescents.summary: Chang'e designed the crescents under the heading OBJECTIVE: KEEP HERSELF SAFE. At the first test they rose a hand's width and dropped. At the crater's edge, on her words "Aspirant power, guide me," they rose and circled her. When an Ender's chest splits to strike, a crescent is already in it, then snaps back. One cracked taking a blow meant for her. With Lesley at her back they fly farther and come back brighter. Under the Storm Citadel's field they fell ringing to the floor, and when it died they lifted again.
rows: Crescent pieces, white edged with pink
